what: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpcubeR downloads reads Florida Pasture Cube R. Florida Pasture Cube describes 62,847 persistent pasture fields Florida (0.98 million ha) every 5 days January 2016 October 2026. field holds: Optical: Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS) reflectance five spectral indices. Radar: Sentinel-1 backscatter. Weather: PRISM daily weather. Field attributes: soil, terrain wetland attributes. Labels: county drought, state pasture condition hurricane records. Every composite can traced satellite acquisitions came . package turns ordinary R data frames sf objects. functions select fields, read time series remove gap-filled values unless ask . also join drought map, compute anomalies field’s climatology, plot fields series.

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: Every example runs small real extract shipped package. holds nine fields, three tier, Hardee, DeSoto Highlands counties. Composites cover 2021–2023, observations labels cover 2022. fpc_example_dir() points , can run examples without downloading anything. full data, drop dir = d argument.
code: library(fpcubeR)  # 1. Download the fields, the 5-day composites of 2022 and the labels (about 230 MB) fpc_download(c("fields", "composites", "labels"), years = 2022)  # 2. Pick fields: tier A (parcels coded as grazing land) in Hardee County f <- fpc_fields(tier = "A", county = "Hardee")  # 3. Read their NDVI, Sentinel-1 VV backscatter and rainfall, observed values only x <- fpc_composites(f, vars = c("ndvi", "vv_db", "ppt_sum"), years = 2022)  # 4. Plot one field fpc_plot_field(f$field_id[1], years = 2022) library(fpcubeR) d <- fpc_example_dir()

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: Fields. field connected part persistent pasture inside one tax parcel, least 2 ha. conservative set grazing fields use tier . Tier C contains wetter pastures. Owner information never downloaded, parcel identifiers distributed. Calendar. Composites cover 5-day periods anchored 1 January 2016, 791 periods 29 October 2026. date first day period. Composites. variable column, four groups: Optical: HLS reflectance (blue SWIR-2), NDVI, EVI, NDMI, MNDWI, NBR, within-field NDVI standard deviation water fraction. Counts: n_optical_obs, gap_filled n_radar_obs. Radar: Sentinel-1 VV, VH VH−VV dB. Weather: PRISM 5-day rainfall, mean, minimum maximum temperature, maximum vapour-pressure deficit. Gap-filling. Optical gaps 30 days filled linear interpolation flagged. interpolated value uses next observation, must used forecasts analysis causal. fpc_composites() sets values NA default. Files Zenodo.

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpc_download() downloads parts ask Zenodo record data folder: checks MD5 checksum every file. unpacks zipped folders, data folder layout release. skips files already present intact, running completes missing. default downloads fields, composites labels. Use years download years composites.
code: fpc_download()                                                # fields + all composites + labels (~2.4 GB) fpc_download(c("fields", "composites"), years = 2020:2022)    # three years only fpc_download("optical")                                       # per-acquisition HLS records (4 GB) fpc_download("docs")                                          # DATASHEET.md and checksums

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpc_fields() reads fields.parquet returns sf object. geometry EPSG:5070 (CONUS Albers, metres). can filter tier, county (case-insensitive, without “County”) field identifier, choose columns. geometry = FALSE get plain data frame, faster. main columns : Identity: field_id fid (identifier text integer), tier, county, county_fips, parcel use code dor_use_code ag_exempt. Shape: area_ha, perimeter_m, compactness, n_parts pixel counts. Land-cover history: pasture_frac_2016 … pasture_frac_2025, Cropland Data Layer pasture fraction year. Soil: majority map unit, AWS, SOC, drainage class, flooding, hydrologic group water-table depth. Terrain: elevation, slope, TWI HAND. Wetlands: wetland fraction field 500 m ring. Quality flags: flag_few_interior, flag_landuse_change, flag_no_optical flag_no_observations. DATASHEET.md, part "docs", documents every column.
code: f <- fpc_fields(dir = d) f[, c("field_id", "tier", "county", "area_ha", "hand_mean_m", "drainage_class")] #> Simple feature collection with 9 features and 6 fields #> Geometry type: POLYGON #> Dimension:     XY #> Bounding box:  xmin: 1386915 ymin: 555975 xmax: 1487055 ymax: 609495 #> Projected CRS: NAD83 / Conus Albers #>    field_id tier    county area_ha hand_mean_m          drainage_class                       geometry #> 1 FPC059432    B    Hardee    8.28   8.0297442 Somewhat poorly drained POLYGON ((1392525 609495, 1... #> 2 FPC060780    A    Hardee   16.65   0.9626154          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1387455 605895, 1... #> 3 FPC061123    A    Hardee   10.53   0.6225764          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1391325 604905, 1... #> 4 FPC061831    B    Hardee   34.83   1.1661365          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1391475 601725, 1... #> 5 FPC062581    B    Hardee   20.97   0.8724991          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1393035 599535, 1... #> 6 FPC062877    A    Hardee  115.74   1.7260204          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1390095 597435, 1... #> 7 FPC094408    C Highlands   15.48   0.5854164          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1486815 581205, 1... #> 8 FPC094588    C    DeSoto   14.94   1.2259987          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1387515 576585, 1... #> 9 FPC095347    C    DeSoto   49.95   1.0317036          Poorly drained POLYGON ((1417245 557295, 1... fpc_fields(tier = "C", geometry = FALSE, dir = d)[, c("field_id", "county", "area_ha", "pasture_years_mean")] #>    field_id    county area_ha pasture_years_mean #> 1 FPC094408 Highlands   15.48           5.052326 #> 2 FPC094588    DeSoto   14.94           3.132530 #> 3 FPC095347    DeSoto   49.95           1.209009 nrow(fpc_fields(county = "Hardee", geometry = FALSE, dir = d)) #> [1] 6

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpc_observations() reads records behind composites, one row per field acquisition. Optical (HLS): sensor (L30 Landsat, S30 Sentinel-2), MGRS tile, granule, clear total field pixels, field-mean reflectance indices, estimated geometric shift quality flags. default keeps records enter composites (qa_use). title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpc_labels() reads one label tables: "usdm": US Drought Monitor county week, percent area D0–D4 (cumulative), dominant class DSCI. "nass": weekly NASS pasture condition Florida, poor excellent, condition index. "tracks": six-hourly positions every storm within 3° Florida. "landfalls": Florida landfalls. Times UTC. Landfalls storms yet HURDAT2 derived track, source column says .

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: fpc_add_drought() adds US Drought Monitor map field’s county valid date: usdm_class: 0 none, 1 D0, 2 D1, 3 D2, 4 D3, 5 D4. highest category covers least half county. usdm_d1_pct: percent county D1 worse. dsci: Drought Severity Coverage Index, 0 500.
code: xd <- fpc_add_drought(x, dir = d) table(class = xd$usdm_class) #> class #>   0   1   2  #> 460  68 129

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: Hurricane Ian made landfall south-west Florida 28 September 2022 crossed Hardee DeSoto counties. map draws six-hourly track top example fields.  Rainfall, VV backscatter observed NDVI nine fields around landfall. Ian brought 200 mm days. effect composites short-lived small, paper describes.
code: tr <- fpc_labels("tracks", d) ian <- tr[tr$name == "IAN" & format(tr$time, "%Y") == "2022", ] ian_line <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_linestring(as.matrix(ian[, c("lon", "lat")])), crs = 4326) ian_line <- sf::st_transform(ian_line, 5070) box <- sf::st_bbox(sf::st_buffer(sf::st_union(f), 60000)) cen <- sf::st_sf(tier = f$tier, geometry = sf::st_centroid(sf::st_geometry(f))) ggplot() +   geom_sf(data = ian_line, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +   geom_sf(data = cen, aes(colour = tier), size = 2.5) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2f7bd9", B = "#ef6a3a", C = "#1fae7a")) +   coord_sf(xlim = box[c(1, 3)], ylim = box[c(2, 4)]) +   labs(title = "Hurricane Ian (2022) and the example fields", colour = "Tier") xi <- fpc_composites(f, vars = c("ppt_sum", "vv_db", "ndvi"), from = "2022-08-15", to = "2022-11-15",                      long = TRUE, dir = d) xi$tier <- f$tier[match(xi$field_id, f$field_id)] ggplot(xi[!is.na(xi$value), ], aes(date, value, group = field_id, colour = tier)) +   geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2022-09-28"), linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) + geom_point(size = 0.7) +   facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y",              labeller = as_labeller(c(ppt_sum = "rainfall (mm / 5 days)", vv_db = "VV (dB)",                                       ndvi = "NDVI (observed)"))) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(A = "#2f7bd9", B = "#ef6a3a", C = "#1fae7a")) +   labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Tier", title = "Around Ian's landfall (dashed line)")

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: example computes field’s NDVI anomaly 2021–2022 climatology. colours every observation county drought class week.
code: ad <- fpc_add_drought(a, dir = d) ad <- ad[!is.na(ad$anomaly), ] ad$drought <- factor(ad$usdm_class, levels = 0:5, labels = c("none", "D0", "D1", "D2", "D3", "D4")) ggplot(ad, aes(date, anomaly)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +   geom_point(aes(colour = drought), size = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +   geom_smooth(se = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5, span = 0.15, method = "loess", formula = y ~ x) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c(none = "#9fb7c9", D0 = "#f2d45c", D1 = "#f1a340", D2 = "#d7301f",                                  D3 = "#7f0000", D4 = "#3b0000"), drop = TRUE) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "NDVI anomaly", colour = "County drought",        title = "Observed NDVI anomaly of the nine fields (reference 2021-2022)")

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: per-acquisition table shows sensor observed field . also shows clear sky dry season clouds wet season (June–September) shape record.
code: oa <- fpc_observations("optical", years = 2022, usable_only = FALSE, dir = d) oa$use <- ifelse(oa$qa_use, "used", "rejected") oa$month <- as.integer(format(oa$date, "%m")) ggplot(oa, aes(month, fill = interaction(sensor, use, sep = ", "))) +   geom_bar(width = 0.8) +   scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +   scale_fill_manual(values = c("L30, used" = "#2f7bd9", "S30, used" = "#1fae7a",                                "L30, rejected" = "#b7cdea", "S30, rejected" = "#b8e3d0")) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "field-acquisitions", fill = NULL,        title = "HLS acquisitions of the nine fields in 2022, by sensor and screening")

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: Sentinel-1 views field different relative orbits, incidence angle changes. Compare backscatter within one orbit, normalise orbit, read changes dates.
code: ra <- fpc_observations("radar", years = 2022, dir = d) ra$orbit <- factor(ra$relative_orbit) ggplot(ra, aes(as.Date(date), vv_db, colour = orbit)) +   geom_point(size = 0.8) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "VV (dB)", colour = "Relative orbit",        title = "Sentinel-1 VV of the nine fields in 2022, by relative orbit")

title: fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube in R
text: NASS reports weekly pasture condition whole state. example compares median NDVI anomaly nine fields. full data code gives statewide comparison paper.
code: nass <- fpc_labels("nass", d) nass$week_ending <- as.Date(nass$week_ending) nass <- nass[nass$week_ending >= as.Date("2021-01-01") & nass$week_ending <= as.Date("2023-12-31"), ] sa <- fpc_summarise(a, "anomaly") sc <- function(z) (z - mean(z, na.rm = TRUE)) / stats::sd(z, na.rm = TRUE) both <- rbind(data.frame(date = sa$date, value = sc(sa$value), series = "NDVI anomaly (median of fields)"),               data.frame(date = nass$week_ending, value = sc(nass$condition_index),                          series = "NASS pasture condition index")) ggplot(both, aes(date, value, colour = series)) +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +   scale_colour_manual(values = c("#1b5e3b", "#c2662d")) +   labs(x = NULL, y = "standardised", colour = NULL, title = "Greenness and reported pasture condition") +   theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Tier B includes mowed grassland pastures parcels use codes. Tier C comes official land-use maps. CDL pasture fractions low construction, flag_landuse_change apply . Small fields. fields 5 ha, read optical observations. Keep records qa_geometry_status == "pass", consider dropping fields flag_few_interior. Radar. Account change relative orbit periods (example 5).
